scenarios.name: Share the panel-title setting between two ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon shows panel titles
the user clears Show Panel Titles from the 3D Model tab context menu
the user selects the Tools tab
the Tools panel titles are hidden
the user opens the Tools tab context menu
the user selects Show Panel Titles from that menu
the 3D Model panel titles are visible
